title: the close of a canonical-workflow project: the COO's COMPLETION REPORT and the CTO's COMPLETION GRADES (spine L10, the close)
description: Two documents, two authors, one schema. The COO writes ledger/COMPLETION_REPORT.round<N>.json when the decomposition is spent (every cell has a terminal task order with a valid proof-of-spec): one row per outcome in the PRD header, the cells that served it, each cell's proof, and the COO's CLAIM on the coverage axis. The CTO writes ledger/COMPLETION_GRADES.round<N>.json after reading the exercised artifact each outcome's DONE WHEN names, never the report: one VERDICT per outcome on the realization axis. The CLOSED flip is mechanical on the grades (.tools/missions-tree-index.py check, rule R6). Authority: Andrew-direct at the CTO terminal 2026-09-03 ~05:2xZ, record org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/ANDREW_DIRECT_20260903_052xZ_WHO_DECIDES_DONE_COO_COMPLETION_REPORT_CTO_GRADES_TWO_READS.md ('at least two agents have a chance of assessing the true finished status' / 'Do it').

x-rule24.declared_domain: the finished status of one project, as a function of its PRD header's endpoint_outcomes (FWD-1..n)
x-rule24.postulate_i_mece: claim over {COVERED, UNCOVERED} partitions every outcome by whether at least one cell with a terminal, proved task order served it; verdict over {REALIZED, NOT_REALIZED, NOT_EVALUATED} partitions every outcome by whether the exercised artifact meets the card's DONE WHEN -- NOT_EVALUATED is present so that a row nobody read is never encoded as a verdict
x-rule24.postulate_ii_same_grain: one row per FWD id in the PRD header, in both documents; the gate refuses a document whose ids are not exactly the header's set
x-rule24.postulate_iii_intent_coherence: claim is the COVERAGE axis and is the COO's; verdict is the REALIZATION axis and is the CTO's; neither document carries the other's field, so agreement between them is corroboration across axes and never repetition on one
x-rule24.postulate_iv_state_coherence: UNCOVERED is moved only by L5 (a cell added), never by grading; NOT_REALIZED is moved by L5 (a cell missing) or L2 (the outcome itself wrong, adjudicated by the CTO), never by re-grading the same artifact; NOT_EVALUATED is moved only by the CTO reading the artifact, or by the CTO's self-adjudication when the artifact cannot be read
x-rule24.autonomy_after_L2: Andrew-direct 2026-09-03 ~05:2xZ: 'after that point [his L2 confirmation of the DONE WHEN lines], no matter what happens, I want the canonical loop to be able to keep cycling in its pattern and get the thing done'. NO ROW OF THE CLOSE WAITS ON ANDREW: a card whose DONE WHEN names him is graded by the CTO on the record that the artifact reached him. A grade in question on receipt, or a SCOPE_CHANGE, is adjudicated by the CTO itself (/open-calls on the subject, the CTO rules on the recommendations, records the ruling, amends or re-issues the endpoint and the PRD) and the loop runs forward from L4.
x-rule24.token_census: COVERED / UNCOVERED / REALIZED / NOT_REALIZED / NOT_EVALUATED: new as whole-value tokens in org/standards at authoring; APPLIED / EXERCISED reuse the /endpoint --forward DONE WHEN states verbatim (same concept, same grain, renaming would be the defect)

x-homes.consumer: .tools/missions-tree-index.py check -- rule R6 refuses a project.json dep_stage CLOSED unless both documents exist for the same round, their fwd ids equal the PRD header's endpoint_outcomes exactly, and every verdict is REALIZED

ref_at_vintage.description: a repo path or S3/URL plus '@<commit-ish or ISO instant>' -- a citation without a vintage is not a citation

written_by.description: the L5/L6 owner; the only seat that can say the decomposition is spent

done_when_text.description: the card's DONE WHEN line, copied verbatim from the PRD's ENDPOINT section

claim.description: the COO's coverage claim -- COVERED = at least one cell with a terminal, proved task order served this outcome; UNCOVERED = no such cell (the report's own shape surfaces a spent decomposition that never held a cell for the outcome)

graded_by.description: the L2 owner: acceptance by the owner of the criteria, against the artifact, never against the report

report_ref.description: the COMPLETION_REPORT graded, at its vintage

artifact_ref.description: the exercised artifact the card's DONE WHEN names, read by the grader; for a card that names Andrew, the record that the artifact reached him -- no row waits on his word after L2

state_observed.description: what the artifact shows; a card whose DONE WHEN is EXERCISED is not met by APPLIED

route.description: on NOT_REALIZED: a cell missing re-enters at L5 (COO); the outcome itself wrong re-enters at L2, where the CTO adjudicates it (/open-calls on the subject, the CTO rules) and the loop runs forward from L4

adjudication_ref.description: the CTO's recorded self-adjudication when the grade was in question on receipt or the route is SCOPE_CHANGE
